description: This file contains unit tests for the 'monitor-onchar' module, specifically testing prefix resolution and stripping functions using the 'vitest' testing framework.

methods.name: resolveOncharPrefixes
methods.description: Resolves an array of prefixes, trimming whitespace and providing default prefixes if input is undefined or empty.

methods.name: stripOncharPrefix
methods.description: Removes the first matching prefix from the input string based on provided prefixes, returning whether a prefix was triggered and the stripped string.
